angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 73,883,340 km at 2452.70 pc = 0.4 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AV Sgr: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 2452.7 +/- 198.3 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 2452.7 +/- 198.3 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.3524 +/- 0.0252 mas (same row, RUWE 0.84), 14.0 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 106.2 +/- 8.4 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AV Sgr: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 106.2 +/- 8.4 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 73,883,340 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4875 +/- 153 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 24, Name='AV Sgr', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4875 +/- 153 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
